plain: The act of breaking a law or crossing into someone's rights

webster.text: Act of violating; breach; violation; non-fulfillment; as the infringement of a treaty, compact or other agreement; the infringement of a law or constitution.

example.quote: We shall be told we have violated it, because we have left it for the infringement and violation of conditions which they never agreed to be a part of the ratification.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
